summary: Applied both spec-review blocking repairs: upgrade invocation boundary and config.local overlay compatibility.

items.title: Define the upgrade invocation boundary
items.rationale: Specified that automatic upgrade must run through a captured normal `senti upgrade` CLI entrypoint or an equivalent adapter, and prohibited unsafe in-process calls that let `process.exit` bypass plugin output.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow[2], overview.decisions[6], and tasks[1].implementation_notes now define the invocation boundary.

items.title: Preserve config.local plugin overlay behavior
items.rationale: Added compatibility requirements and acceptance coverage so automatic-upgrade metadata may use merged config without persisting overlay-only private plugin source/package data to public config.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow[5], overview.decisions[7], requirements[9], acceptance_criteria[10], and tasks[0] now cover config.local overlay compatibility.
